units: Values preserved in the scale provided by the source (continuous values divided by 200). No undocumented unit reinterpretation.
model_selection: lowest arithmetic mean fold MAE; exact ties use order Referencia, Regressao_linear, Floresta
evaluation: only selected procedure and predefined median reference on test after selection saved
prediction_policy: continuous predictions, no rounding or clipping
predictor_policy: three positive finite external measurements chosen before model fitting; no use of Sex, Height, Shucked_weight, Viscera_weight or Shell_weight
data_quality: Abort on missing/nonfinite/nonpositive chosen predictors or nonpositive/noninteger target; no silent row deletion. id_registo is not biological proof of independence.
hypothesis_scope: descriptive held-out evaluation under random row split in the available data; no geographic, temporal, causal or individual error guarantee
